title: Storage splits into three layers: semantic, audit, cosmetic
context: Alternative approaches: single unified layer; two-layer split; no explicit layering.
decision: Schematify stores data in three layers: (1) semantic (nodes, edges, screens, flows, decisions, rules, libraries), (2) audit (runs and lifecycle audit logs), (3) cosmetic (layout positions and viewport state). Each layer has different write patterns and permissions.
consequences: Permission boundaries can split along these lines; agents can write audit data without touching design; layout drags do not dirty semantic files; the split is the enforcement mechanism for the rule that agents cannot change the design unreviewed.
